\begin{tikzpicture}
	\begin{pgfonlayer}{nodelayer}
		\node [style=Process] (0) at (0, 3) {Start};
		\node [style=Decision, below right=9mm and 1cm of 0] (1) {OK?};
		\node [style=Process, above right=1cm and 1.1cm of 1] (2) {Fix};
		\node [style=Process, right=of 1] (3) {Done};
	\end{pgfonlayer}
	\begin{pgfonlayer}{edgelayer}
		\draw [style=Arrow] (0) to (1);
		\draw [style=Arrow] (1) to (2);
		\draw [style=Arrow, bend right=45] (2) to (0);
		\draw [style=Arrow] (1) to (3);
	\end{pgfonlayer}
\end{tikzpicture}
